slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
【大脑寄存处】
夏潮季最后的热风抚过连绵的莽荒森林，树叶如同海浪起伏，沙沙摩挲声如同一曲助眠小调。
突然，一道灰褐色人影从树影中钻出，他脚步沉重，身形却格外敏捷，在灌木和树枝间快速穿行，留下一阵树枝抽打皮甲发出的噼啪声。
“呜呖～哇啦！”
几秒后，伴随着尖锐难听的怪叫声，十几个身材矮小的绿色怪物也拨开草丛钻了出来，吼叫着掷出手中的石块后，便高举手中简陋的武器，继续追逐而去。
听着仿佛从四面八方同时传来的怪叫，还有投掷物和树木的碰撞声，沃尔缩着脖子加快脚步，同时忍不住在心中暗骂：
“该死的背叛者，下地狱的狗种，相信他们说的话，不如去亲吻地精的脚趾！”
就在十几分钟前，那冒险团队长还述说着豪言壮语，队友们众志成城，仿佛传奇冒险者之路就从此开启。
没想到，只是遇到一群穿着树叶，手拿骨锤木棍的哥布林，未来的传奇冒险团便遭遇了滑铁卢。
这些家伙不仅瞬间将沃尔护于身前，还在他准备展露自己正式职业者的实力，带领队伍反击时做鸟兽散，让他独自承受十几个哥布林的围攻。
正所谓双拳难敌四手，即使沃尔已经是掌握战技的职业战士，也没办法打过士气高涨的十几只哥布林。
这些尖耳朵的绿色矮子虽然只是低级的魔物，身材矮小瘦削，智力也只有人类儿童水平，落单时，一个强壮的农夫就足以应对。
但它们终究是魔物，不仅性格凶残嗜血，在数量有着压倒性优势时，还会展露出恐怖的攻击性。
好在被队友抛弃的沃尔对自己的实力有着清晰的认知，并没有逞能。
他果断将肩上背包砸出，然后一个折转冲锋，将侧面的两只哥布林用顺势劈砍倒在地，然后便是开始在树林中急急而奔。
沃尔虽然在逃命，但还是眼观六路，耳听八方，寻找方向的同时，还将森林中的危险一一避开，在职业者学校做的训练这时便得到了充分的展示。
“甜果树林，树藤……终于到了！”
他逐渐放慢脚步，小心翼翼地越过腐植叶凸起的部分，弯腰避开从树上垂落的粗壮藤条，任由哥布林那尖锐的声音越来越接近。
很快，沃尔避开藤条密集的地方，找到了一根枯木下的凹陷，快速矮身蹲伏过去，还不忘给背后冲过来那几只哥布林竖起一根中指。
“呜哇！”

领头的哥布林哪能受这气，张开长着参差不齐尖牙的大嘴，便是一阵怪叫，等到其他方向的哥布林都聚拢过来，这才高举武器，对着躺下的猎物发起胜利冲锋。
沃尔侧躺在凹陷中，一手紧握剑柄，一手护住脑袋，心中默数：
“三……二……”
突然，哗啦啦～
大树间盘绕的树藤无风而动，无数粗壮的藤条如同绳索垂落而下，地面下一阵蠕动，无数藤条如同蟒蛇般游走！
前一秒还志得意满的哥布林们瞬间慌乱起来，连忙躲避，但藤条来回扫荡，很快就将这些哥布林死死缠绕，任由它们抓挠撕咬。
沃尔同样遭到了攻击，虽然背靠枯树，身处凹陷，腿上和手臂还是挨了几鞭，即使隔着布甲和皮甲，被打中的地方依旧火辣辣地疼。
“嘶～这恶魔藤蔓好大的力气！”
content_en:
【Brain Storage】
The last hot wind of the summer tide caresses through the continuous wild forest, the leaves rise and fall like the waves, and the rustling sound is like a melody to help you sleep.
Suddenly, a gray-brown figure emerged from the shadow of the tree. His steps were heavy, but his figure was extremely agile. He walked quickly among the shrubs and branches, leaving behind a crackling sound of branches hitting his leather armor.
"Wow~wow!"
A few seconds later, accompanied by sharp and unpleasant screams, a dozen short green monsters also pushed through the grass and emerged. After roaring and throwing stones in their hands, they raised their crude weapons and continued to chase.
Listening to the strange screams that seemed to come from all directions at the same time, as well as the collision of thrown objects and trees, Wall shrank his neck and quickened his pace, and at the same time couldn't help but curse in his heart:
"Damn traitors, you damn dogs, believe what they say, why not kiss the goblin's toes!"
Just ten minutes ago, the adventure team leader was uttering heroic words, and the teammates were united, as if the path of a legendary adventurer had just begun.
Unexpectedly, just encountering a group of goblins wearing leaves and holding bone hammers and sticks, the future legendary adventure group would encounter Waterloo.
Not only did these guys protect Wall in an instant, but they also dispersed when he was about to show his true professional strength and lead the team to counterattack, leaving him to bear the siege of more than a dozen goblins alone.
As the saying goes, two fists are hard to beat with four hands. Even if Wall is already a professional warrior who has mastered combat skills, he can't beat a dozen goblins with high morale.
Although these green dwarfs with pointed ears are just low-level monsters, they are short and thin, and their intelligence is only at the level of human children. When alone, a strong farmer can handle them.
But they are monsters after all. Not only are they cruel and bloodthirsty, but they will also show terrifying aggression when they have an overwhelming advantage in numbers.
Fortunately, Wall, who was abandoned by his teammates, had a clear understanding of his own strength and did not show off.
He decisively smashed out the backpack on his shoulder, then turned and charged, slashing the two goblins on the side to the ground, and then began to run quickly in the woods.
Although Wall was running for his life, he still kept his eyes and ears in all directions. While looking for the direction, he also avoided the dangers in the forest one by one. The training he did in the professional school was fully demonstrated at this time.
"Sweet fruit forest, tree vines... finally arrived!"
He gradually slowed down, carefully crossed the raised part of the humus leaves, bent down to avoid the thick rattan hanging from the tree, and allowed the sharp voice of the goblin to get closer and closer.
Soon, Wall avoided the dense cane area and found a depression under a dead tree. He quickly squatted down and gave a middle finger to the goblins rushing behind him.
"Whoa!"
The leading goblin couldn't bear this anger. He opened his big mouth with jagged fangs and let out a strange scream. When the goblins from other directions gathered around, he raised his weapon and launched a victorious charge towards the lying prey.
Wall lay on his side in the depression, holding the sword hilt tightly with one hand and protecting his head with the other, silently counting in his mind:
"Three...two..."
Suddenly, clatter~
The vines coiled between the big trees moved without wind, and countless thick vines hung down like ropes. There was a squirming movement under the ground, and countless vines swam like pythons!
The goblins who were so proud a second ago panicked and hurriedly evaded, but the canes swept back and forth and quickly entangled the goblins tightly, allowing them to scratch and bite.
Wall was also attacked. Although his back was against a dead tree and he was in a dent, his legs and arms were whipped several times. Even through cloth and leather armor, the places where he was hit still hurt.
"Hiss~ This demonic vine is so powerful!"
